name: youtube-audio-caster-mobile
description: Phone control surface for YouTube Audio Caster. Talks to the desktop app over the local network; it is not a second copy of it.

scripts.prepare:android: npm run sync:www && npm run icons && cap sync android
scripts.prepare:ios: npm run sync:www && npm run icons && cap sync ios
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
